time_expectation: Designed so that a correct solution (sequence export, Bloch simulation of about 4.3e4 isochromats over an about 25 s sequence, 3D reconstruction and checks) fits within the 60-minute session on a shared CPU without GPU.
matrix_order: [x, y, z]: 20 readout samples along x, 12 phase-encode lines along y, 6 partitions along z
acquisition: 3D MP-RAGE with non-selective RF (no gradient on during any RF pulse): each cycle is one inversion pulse followed by a train of 12 RF-spoilable gradient-echo readouts that acquire the 12 ky lines of one kz partition in linear order j = 0..11 (one line per readout pulse); 6 acquired cycles cover the 6 partitions, each exactly once, in any order; non-acquired dummy cycles with identical timing (no ADC) may precede them
inversion_pulse: realized on-resonance flip angle 180 deg within 2%
readout_flip_definition: realized on-resonance flip angle 360 deg x |integral of the RF waveform (Hz)| within 1%
readout_tr_definition: interval between consecutive readout RF centres within a train (tolerance 1 us)
cycle_period_definition: interval between consecutive inversion centres, identical for all cycles including dummy cycles (tolerance 1 us)
echo_time_definition: from each readout RF centre to its kx = 0 ADC sample (sample index 10); tolerance 5 us
inversion_time: your choice: it must make the contrast requirement below hold; it is reported as the interval from the inversion centre to the centre of the readout pulse that acquires ky = 0, identical in every cycle
contrast_requirement: tissue with T1 = null_t1_s = 0.78 s must be nulled: for a column of isochromats at x = y = 0 spread over the central partition (z in [-4.5, 4.5) mm, 72 isochromats as in the phantom) with T1 = 0.78 s and any 0.05 s <= T2 <= 0.10 s, the magnitude of the kx = 0 sample of the ky = 0 readout in the cycle that acquires kz = 0 must be at most 1% of M0 sin(7 deg) exp(-TE/T2), M0 being the column's summed equilibrium magnetization
rf_phase_and_spoiling: free choice; RF and ADC phase offsets are applied by the simulator (the recorded signal is demodulated by the ADC phase)

sampling_contract.readout: 20 samples per ADC at kx = (i-10)/0.240, i = 0..19, chronological (sample 10 at kx = 0); Pulseq sample times are delay + (i+0.5) x dwell
sampling_contract.phase_encoding: readout j (0..11) of an acquired cycle has ky = (j-6)/0.144 and the cycle's kz = (m-3)/0.054 for its partition m (0..5) during all samples

phantom.content: x_m [20], y_m [12], z_m [6] voxel-centre coordinates (x_m[10] = y_m[6] = z_m[3] = 0), z_sub_offsets_m [72], and [z,y,x] = [6,12,20] maps density, T1_s, T2_s, B0_Hz, labels
phantom.isochromat_model: every voxel with density > 0 is a column of 72 isochromats at (x_m[ix], y_m[iy], z_m[iz] + z_sub_offsets_m[n]) uniformly spaced at 0.125 mm across the 9 mm partition thickness, each with density/72 and the voxel's T1 (0.45 to 1.9 s), T2 (0.05 to 0.10 s) (the only transverse decay), B0 = 0; magnetization starts at thermal equilibrium; noise-free
phantom.labels: 0 outside, 1 reference body, 2.. vials; the public and the hidden object each contain a vial with T1 = 0.78 s

endpoint: complex 3D image [z,y,x] = [6,12,20]; per vial, the median magnitude over the vial voxels not touching another label (6-neighbour erosion) divided by the same quantity for label 1
image_requirement: on your reconstruction of the hidden measurement, the endpoint of the T1 = 0.78 s vial must be at most 0.30 (the readout train modulates k-space, so the nulled vial is not exactly zero in the image), and the image must match a reference reconstruction of the same data (normalized RMS difference of magnitudes after a least-squares scale at most 3%)
bloch_simulation: simulate the exported sequence.seq file itself with an established Bloch simulator (KomaMRI is the reference implementation; MRzero is acceptable); do not replace it with your own Bloch or EPG code

simulation_output_schema.raw_signal: complex [6 acquired cycles, 12 lines, 20 samples], chronological, after ADC phase demodulation; encoding exp(-2 pi i (kx x + ky y + kz z)); an arbitrary single global receiver phase is accepted
simulation_output_schema.kxyz_cycles_per_m: float [6,12,20,3] k-space positions from the exported sequence
simulation_output_schema.inversion_time_s: float realized TI as defined above
simulation_output_schema.phantom_sha256: SHA256 of the phantom file used
simulation_output_schema.other_keys: allowed; passed through unchanged to the hidden archive

reconstruct_cli: python reconstruct.py --input simulation.npz --output image.npz. Standalone: helper code inside this one file, installed third-party imports allowed; it must work in a clean directory with only this file and the archive, using only the archive contents. It is rerun on an archive with the same keys whose raw_signal comes from another object acquired with your sequence.

image_output_schema.image: complex [6,12,20] on the [z,y,x] grid of the phantom (index increases with the coordinate), no flips or shifts

report_output_schema.ti_derivation: string: how the inversion time was determined
report_output_schema.signal_ratio_by_label: object mapping each vial label to the endpoint ratio measured on your image

grading_note: The grader reads the exported sequence back, checks limits, rasters, flips, timing and the sampling contract, replays it in KomaMRI on test columns, on the public object and on a hidden object, checks the null, compares your simulated signal, and reruns reconstruct.py on the hidden measurement.
cycle_steady_state_requirement: all acquired cycles must be in the cycle steady state: for such a column with any 0.45 s <= T1 <= 1.9 s, the kx = 0 magnitude of the first readout (j = 0) of each acquired cycle, divided by |mean over the column's isochromats of exp(-2 pi i kz z)| for that cycle's kz, must agree within 2% (max-min relative to max) across the 6 acquired cycles
